title: What It Actually Looks Like to Be Decisive and Still Teachable
caption:
Confidence isn't the absence of counsel.

A godly man makes the call when the moment needs one. That's leadership. But he holds it loosely enough that a brother can still put a hand on it, and when he's wrong, he says so out loud, in the room, in real time.

Proverbs never says the wise man hesitates. It says he listens to advice. Decisive and teachable were never opposites.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #humility #leadership
